screener_description: Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited operates a multi-specialty pediatric, obstetrics, and gynecology hospital chain in India. The company offers a wide range of services such as newborn and pediatric intensive care, pediatric multi-specialty services, pediatric quaternary care, obstetrics, and gynecology. [1] It is country’s largest pediatric hospital chain with 16 hospitals spread across 6 cities. [2]
